verses.text: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
From the evil of the retreating whisperer[1] -
Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
From among the jinn and mankind".[2]

footnotes.1: i.e., a devil who makes evil suggestions to man but disappears when one remembers Allāh.
footnotes.2: Evil prompters may be from men as well as from jinn.
